title: Turkish-Style Kofte Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish made with flavorful kofte meatballs, served with a side of toasted bread and a fresh salad.

ingredients.name: Kofte meatballs ( Turkish-style beef and lamb meatballs )
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Thread 4-6 kofte meatballs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each meatball.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kofte meatballs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine chopped parsley, red onion, cucumber, tomato, and red pepper flakes.
Squeeze lemon juice over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve the grilled kofte meatballs with toasted pita bread and a side of the fresh salad.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
